description: Dependabot critical alerts #109 (GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4, RCE in the Image Optimization API with AVIF) and #110 (GHSA-p293-qw3h-jr36, RCE on Windows-hosted servers) flag next >=16.0.0 <16.3.3 in web/package-lock.json. web/package.json and web/bun.lock already pin next 16.3.4 (patched), and CI's web-typecheck job installs with bun install --frozen-lockfile. The npm web/package-lock.json is stale at next 16.2.6: recent Dependabot group bumps (#426) updated bun.lock but not it. Work: determine which lockfile and install command the deployed web build actually uses (Vercel project settings, vercel.json, and code/platform/vercel.md); if the deployed build uses package-lock.json the live site may be running the vulnerable version, which changes the urgency and must be reported immediately. If package-lock.json is unused, remove it and make sure Dependabot and Vercel both key on bun.lock; otherwise regenerate it at 16.3.4. Verify bun install --frozen-lockfile, bun tsc --noEmit and bun run build locally; bun run lint already fails on main (C11-214), so only confirm no new lint errors. Confirm both alerts close after merge.
title: web: critical Next.js RCE alerts flag a stale npm package-lock (next 16.2.6) while bun.lock is already patched
